steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Period Study (Paper 1) is worth 50% of the GCSE and lasts 1 hour 30 minutes | Key Fact: It focuses on narrative, causation, and change and continuity across a broad chronological period | Key Fact: You must know the key events in chronological order — timeline knowledge is essential | Key Fact: Narrative questions ask you to tell the story of events — use chronological structure
